Thai Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:46pm

Ingredients




3 carrots, grated
1/2 jicama, grated
Leaves from Boston, red or green leaf lettuce (or any
1 ripe papaya, sliced
1 handful unsalted peanuts, chopped
1 1/2  limes
Thai dressing (below)
2 tablespoons sesame oil
2 tablespoons hot chile oil
1/4 cup rice vinegar
1/4 cup tamari (or less if like less salty)

Preparation

1 Serves about 4 2 Mix above ingredients together and toss with dressing. 3 Whisk ingredients together. Shake before serving.
